context: Naoko quietly admires the ramen shop she's built over decades.
purpose: Older woman alone with proud reflection; chat with Yumiko.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: この店、長年やってきたなぁ。
lines.en: This shop has been going for so long, hasn't it…
lines.style: Warm, reflective exhale on the opening. Kansai cadence—soft, unhurried. Pride underneath, carefully kept modest. Trailing fondness, like she's looking back at decades.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Well, it really is something to be proud of.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Soft warmth—not flattery, genuine recognition. Slight pause before 「本当に」as if reaching for the right weight of sincerity.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お客さん、ようけ支えてくれた。
lines.en: The customers have supported it so much.
lines.style: Humble, genuine gratitude in the voice. Kansai rhythm—unhurried. A catch of emotion, quickly steadied. Not performing humility, living it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: You can really feel the bond between people in a place like this.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Gentle, almost tender. She's seeing something true and naming it without overstatement. Slow, thoughtful pace. Warmth that sits still.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I've got so much pride in what we've built.
lines.style: Stronger now—conviction rising. Kansai warmth still there but firmer underneath. The word 「誇り」lands with quiet weight. No bravado, just solid truth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Keep going with it, for as long as you can.
lines.style: Gentle encouragement. Not a command—a wish. Warmth that carries a little bit of knowing what it costs. Soft close, like she's already blessing the future.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: You bet I will—as long as I've got the strength!
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. Louder now, more Naoko—still warm but with her characteristic brassy energy. Determination with a laugh underneath. Voice opens up.
